integrity: The proof is an analytic graph-cover and operator-theoretic argument; no finite experiment is used as evidence for an infinite spectral conclusion.
The primary source was inspected at its definitions of invariant line ensembles, Proposition 4.1, and the spectral-bottom argument in Section 4.3.
The comparison distinguishes the source's stated finite-base Hamiltonian theorem from the weaker two-factor hypothesis established here.
scientific_limitations: A spanning two-factor is a sufficient, not claimed necessary, condition for a full invariant line ensemble on the universal cover.
The theorem concerns the unperturbed lifted quantum-tree operator under the primary source's (C1) hypotheses and delta vertex conditions.
Isolated eigenvalues at Dirichlet values are not excluded, and no new random-perturbation endpoint statement is claimed.
title: Spanning two-factors force continuous bands on finite-data quantum trees
